## Summary

Applies to an existing data module the fixes selected from the candidates returned in `fixes[]`. A selection must be a copy of a candidate; a value outside the candidates, or a value that does not fit a range, is put into `rejected[]` with a reason. The result is verified again

## Description returned by `tools/list`

This is the text an LLM receives.

> Apply fixes to an existing data module. Each selection copies the location and ONE candidate of a fix that s1000d-verify-mcp suggest_fixes (or this server) returned: { location, action, target?, value?, position? }. The server computes the fix candidates again and applies a selection only if it matches one of them; a value outside the candidates (or outside a range / pattern candidate) is not applied and comes back in rejected[] with the reason. "provide" candidates change the product, not the document: pass them as "product". The result is verified again. Returns xml, applied[], rejected[], verification, the fixes that remain. Writes only when write is true (a path is overwritten in place; xml is written under its own file name in the first CSDB folder).

## Arguments

The content of `inputSchema`. A nested argument is written as `parent.child`, and an item of an array as `parent[].child`.

| Name | Type | Required | Constraints | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | `string` |  |  | File path of the document. |
| `xml` | `string` |  |  | An existing document as an XML string (alternative to path; max 5 MB). Not for XML you wrote yourself: build new data modules with build_data_module. |
| `csdbDirs` | `array<string>` |  |  | CSDB folders used to resolve references, find BREX and number new objects (default: S1000D_CSDB_DIR / the config file). The FIRST folder is also where write: true writes (it may not exist yet). When given, these folders replace S1000D_CSDB_DIR and the csdbDirs of the config file (they are not added to them); other folders that do not exist are skipped and reported in _notes. |
| `selections` | `array<object>` | Yes | items ≥ 1 |  |
| `selections[].location` | `object` |  |  | Fix.location of the suggestion (omit when the fix has none, e.g. a missing element). |
| `selections[].location.path` | `string` | Yes |  |  |
| `selections[].location.line` | `integer` |  |  |  |
| `selections[].location.column` | `integer` |  |  |  |
| `selections[].action` | `string` | Yes | `replace` / `remove` / `add` / `retarget` / `provide` |  |
| `selections[].target` | `string` |  |  |  |
| `selections[].value` | `string` |  |  |  |
| `selections[].position` | `string` |  | `before` | Copy it when the candidate has "position" (an element added before the one at the location). Without it the selection does not match that candidate. |
| `product` | `object` |  |  | The product to evaluate applicability for. attributes: ACT productAttribute id → value; conditions: CCT cond id → value. Omit to skip the applicability check. |
| `product.attributes` | `object` |  |  |  |
| `product.conditions` | `object` |  |  |  |
| `write` | `boolean` |  | default `false` | Write the result into the CSDB (the first folder of csdbDirs / S1000D_CSDB_DIR). Default false: the XML is only returned. Nothing is written when the XML is not valid against the XSD unless allowInvalid is true. |
| `overwrite` | `boolean` |  | default `false` | With write: true, replace a file of the same name. Default false: an existing file is left alone and reported as write-conflict. |
| `allowInvalid` | `boolean` |  | default `false` | With write: true, write even when verification.schema.state is "invalid". Default false. |
| `maxFixes` | `integer` |  | default `50`, ≥ 1, ≤ 1000 | Cap on the remaining fixes listed in the response (default 50). |
